$comment: Triggers CDM's own physical-column discovery for one CDE. Async — returns a
job_id; the agent reports it and the columns appear in CDE Manager as
KEYWORDS ARE DELIBERATELY NOT DECLARED. `payload.keywords` exists on this
endpoint and supplying it REPLACES the synonyms CDM generated from the CDE's
description. Evidence that CDM's are better: on the GL reconciliation key,
our register's business vocabulary (GL reference, journal entry ID, trade ID)
found nothing, while CDM's generated set contained `recon key`, `GL key` and
`GL reconciliation key` — the forms that actually match GL_RECON_KEY. Leaving
keywords out is what makes the demo claim true: write a good definition, and
only_sources IS declared and should almost always be set. An unscoped
DATA_MAPPING crawls the entire catalog; on a customer instance that is both
slow and noisy. Format is alation://data/<id>.
409 'another action is in progress' — actions serialise per CDE. An agent
doing several CDEs must let one finish before triggering the next.
CDEAction has exactly three values. CALCULATE_CURATION_SCORE and
CALCULATE_DQ_SCORE populate the Curation Completeness and Data Quality tiles,
which read N/A until they are run — DQ stays N/A until monitors exist.
name: Discover CDE Columns
description: Ask Alation to find the physical columns for a Critical Data Element, using the search synonyms it generated from that element's description. Runs asynchronously and returns a job id; the matches appear in CDE Manager marked 'suggested' for a human to accept — nothing is linked automatically. Scope it to a data source. Also used to calculate the curation and data-quality scores, which read N/A until run. Only one action can run on a CDE at a time.

cde_id.description: Numeric id of the CDE, as returned by Create Critical Data Element in this conversation.

action.description: DATA_MAPPING finds physical columns. CALCULATE_CURATION_SCORE fills the Curation Completeness tile. CALCULATE_DQ_SCORE fills the Data Quality tile, and stays N/A until DQ monitors exist.

payload.description: Optional. For DATA_MAPPING, scope the crawl to specific data sources — leaving it unscoped searches the whole catalog.

only_sources.description: Data source keys to search, e.g. ["alation://data/2"].
